hypothesis: Posterior-weighted causal explanations plus a separately ablated uncertainty-aware decision rule can improve action outcomes in novel composed causal regimes over hard MAP graph_recent8 without additional observations, tokens, labels or hidden oracle access.

representation.same_public_graph_grammar: 45 XOR/AND/OR pair rules for m0, 45 for m1, 84 rules over six public x and observed upstream mediator pairs for m2; EXACT original AAI11A graph rule enumeration
representation.history: 8 most recent public observations; identical count and public fields to graph_recent8; do not store action count beyond original public stream
representation.posterior: For each of 3 outputs, integer mismatch counts over last 8 public x and 3 observed mediator bits as original graph_recent8. Weight each hypothesis proportional to exp(-ln(9)*errors), normalization via subtract-min mismatch. Fixed prior uniform, no regime label.
representation.forecast: At any requested unseen x: P(m0=1) weighted sum over 45 graph rules, P(m1=1) likewise, P(m2=1) expectation over 84 downstream graph rules and four possible jointly independent m0,m1 inputs using learned upstream marginals. Round probabilities to 12 decimals for deterministic cross-OS source. No private world law, no oracle, no unchosen observed action consequence.

arms.graph_recent8: ORIGINAL unchanged strongest conventional (MAP rule, 0.1/0.9 bit forecast, shared original planner)
arms.posterior_planner: Matched conventional posterior predictive learner: same 8 public rows, grammar and uniform posterior as candidate, but EXACT original AAI11P controls.plan, no risk penalty.
arms.risk_calibrated_planner: Proposed novel uncertainty-aware decision: same posterior predictive learner; exhaustive original 0,1,2 do-step action enumeration, but score each forecast terminal value as expected correctly matched goal bits - 0.05*total_action_count - 0.5*sqrt(sum(p_j*(1-p_j)) over three bit forecasts). STOP compares against the actual current public reward without risk penalty. Tie handling the same original action order/1e-10 threshold. This is a fixed risk-averse disagreement gate, no tuning from results.

requirements.common_training: 16 A + 16 B actual one-step trials, 64 identical public rows; no stage labels to models
requirements.challenge: 2/4 actual do-action exogenous challenge trials from C/D/E/F; cold-restored independently
requirements.episodes: 12 original AAI11P x/goal contexts for each of C/D/E/F at N2/N4 across 3 exact mechanical fixtures; 288 independent actual consequence episodes per method, max 2 actual interventions; each method sees its own actions and consequences only
requirements.baseline: strongest of original 11 conventional controls in exact original-source run 43640947420 was graph_recent8 2.134027778; verify graph_recent8 exact aggregate again on new run and preserve all source blobs
requirements.single_screen: Run both fixed posterior_planner and risk_calibrated_planner once, same 288 fixture episodes. Admit risk_calibrated ONLY if reward >= old strongest+0.08 (2.214027778) AND exact 3-goal success >=0.60. Posterior_planner is ablation; risk must additionally beat posterior_planner >=+0.03 to attribute added value to risk decision rule.
requirements.next_gate_if_screen_passes: Only after all 3 frozen screen thresholds pass: rerun all 11 existing fully trained conventional controls plus the posterior_planner ablation, confirm risk_candidate best+0.08 over strongest, return-A/B-hold >= strongest-.03, 2x total process cost vs fastest matched across both OS, exact-source final mandatory full regression; no scientific first-use regardless
requirements.if_fail: DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE; stop after first frozen synthetic screen, do not retune beta=ln9, risk lambda=.5 or model rule code, preserve receipts, do not rerun previously qualified costly unrelated conventional benchmarks.
requirements.source_controls: No privilege exposure, immutable prereg committed before candidate code, negative inputs and cold restoration, match public observation budget and action count, no branch/main accepted-ref changes, deterministic paired trace hashes Linux/Windows, source-pinned G29 atlas and full exact SHA repository regression even on development NO-GO.
